gloss: end of the century, fin de siecle

definitions.gloss: end of the century, fin de siecle
definitions.explanation: The closing period of a century, especially associated with cultural decadence, anxiety, or upheaval. Often evokes a mood of decline or apocalyptic atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {世紀末|せいきまつ}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}がある。
examples.english: It has a fin de siecle atmosphere.

examples.japanese: 20{世紀末|せいきまつ}にインターネットが{普及|ふきゅう}した。
examples.english: The internet became widespread at the end of the 20th century.

examples.japanese: {世紀末|せいきまつ}には{退廃的|たいはいてき}な{芸術|げいじゅつ}が{流行|りゅうこう}し、{社会|しゃかい}には{不安|ふあん}が{漂|ただよ}っていた。
examples.english: Decadent art was in vogue at the end of the century, and anxiety pervaded society.

notes:
USAGE:
Beyond its literal meaning, {世紀末|せいきまつ} often carries connotations of chaos, decadence, or an apocalyptic mood. In Japanese pop culture, it is strongly associated with the manga/anime Fist of the North Star ({北斗|ほくと}の{拳|けん}), whose post-apocalyptic setting is described as {世紀末|せいきまつ}.

WORD FORMATION:
{世紀|せいき} (century) + {末|まつ} (end)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世紀末|せいきまつ}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}: fin de siecle atmosphere
- {世紀末|せいきまつ}{的|てき}: apocalyptic, decadent
- {世紀末|せいきまつ}{思想|しそう}: end-of-century thought
